description: This file defines an abstract class Zend_Uri for handling URI schemes within the Zend Framework, including methods for creating, validating, and representing URIs, as well as managing configuration.

classes.name: Zend_Uri
classes.description: An abstract class providing URI handling functionalities such as creation, validation, and string representation within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the URI as a string, with error handling.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a URI string is well-formed and valid.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a new Zend_Uri object for a given URI, supporting different schemes and subclasses.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the scheme part of the URI.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets global configuration options for URI handling.
